decisions.reason: As a prominently launched multi-model operator line in a core application area, it embodies substantial sunk investment and visible commitment, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course now.

Although this operator variant is less prominently positioned and overlaps with the broader operator range, it still sits close to the firm's core offer and management can justify keeping it as part of portfolio fine-tuning rather than abandoning it outright.

The glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's announced direction of flexible, customer-near industrial access solutions, making continued support more likely than withdrawal despite any uneven performance.

Its insulated glazed specification aligns especially well with the firm's compliance-, performance- and customization-based positioning, so management is likely to persist and interpret any weaker results as temporary or segment-specific.
